staff_program: controlled door from lobby to guest wing
housekeeping and linen closets at both corridor ends on both floors
guest_room_program: enclosed private bathroom with washing and toilet fixtures
circulation: lobby to reception and public restroom
controlled lobby door to three-wide central guest corridor
internal lobby stair through a dedicated north landing spine to the second-floor corridor
central corridor through a dedicated south service spine to rear fire doors, landing and exterior stair
corridor access to every guest room and housekeeping closet
damage_constraints: retain an unbroken route from front entrance through lobby to at least one stair
retain at least one usable egress from each surviving floor
damage must follow one localized collapse zone rather than random holes
fixtures and debris must reflect the function of the affected room
keep the clean master immutable; abandoned variants derive from it

required_manual_checks: entrance and road relationship are legible
public, staff and guest zones are distinguishable
every guest room connects to the corridor and contains an enclosed bathroom
stairs and emergency egress are traversable
exterior amenities and service equipment support the motel function
abandoned damage does not erase the building's original use
